name: Danger Tag Desk
office_task: When a tech tags an appliance Danger Do Not Use, note it on the job, draft the written notice to the owner or managing agent that day, and hand it to a named person to send and follow up.
systems_of_record: the job system that issues the job_id (ServiceM8, Simpro, AroFlo or Fergus), where the tag and the notice are recorded
the ledger that issues the invoice_id (Xero), for items raised against an invoice
the exception desk the business runs (a sheet with Raise and Routing tabs, a SharePoint list, or Office Voice's queue), which issues the exception_id
Gmail or Outlook drafts, where the written notice waits for the named person

emits.write: One item per job and type on the exception desk: a danger tag lands as type other with the danger_tag label kept in its reason, the tag photo as evidence, the owner and the same-day clock from the routing table, and the notice on the job record plus a drafted written notice to the property owner or managing agent for that owner to send. Raises from other surfaces are typed from the closed list the same way.
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading it back returns the job_id (or invoice_id), the type, the reason, the due time and the exception_owner; the job note reads back by its note id on the job. No id back means nothing was raised: the raiser is told and the run stops

emits.write: the morning summary, once a day at the set time and also when nothing is open: open items by type and by owner, the overdue ones, the labels that arrived as other, and the jobs with a danger tag still open
emits.readback: the place the office reads it (an email, a Teams channel or a sheet tab) returns a report_id for that day, and a second run that morning reads it back and publishes nothing
